note: Second 4 Sep 2026 batch. Three sources, all identified by eye against the live storefront's lead images before anything was created: (a) twelve saved ezfashion supplier album pages plus two loose album saves, covering Aston Villa, Brighton and Crystal Palace — none of those three clubs had a single listing on the store; (b) three loose supplier photographs of the Aston Villa 26/27 home shirt; (c) a 60-photograph WhatsApp export the client sent at 8.44 PM, which turned out to be a full Germany and Spain range plus one South Africa shirt, not more English stock. Photo keys: zN = the Nth photo of the WhatsApp export in timestamp order, aN.k = the kth image of the Nth album folder (alphabetical), LN = the Nth loose file. Files are staged in import/batch-0904b by scripts/stage-0904b.py.
dedupeNote: Checked against every Germany and Spain listing already live (11 of them) by comparing full image sets, not titles. Six garments in the WhatsApp export are already on the store and are recorded under heldBack rather than imported. The two English clubs and Aston Villa had nothing to collide with. One garment slipped that net: a South Africa shirt in a Germany/Spain export, checked only after the import when the live South Africa count came back higher than expected. Compare a mixed batch against every team it touches, not the teams its filename implies.
priceNote: Client's standing table: fan R500 (S-4XL), fan long sleeve R600, player R650 (S-2XL), player long sleeve R750, retro R700, kids R450, half-zip training set R850, jacket or windbreaker R1000, training top and shorts R600. Retro long sleeve is R800 in the supplier's own classifier (retro +R100, matching how fan long sleeve sits above fan) — that answers the question left open in client-brief-2026-09-04.md, and no garment in this batch needs it anyway.
seasonNote: A season is asserted only where the garment dates itself — a sponsor, a competition patch, a crest star count or a design that is unmistakably one year's. Everything else is titled by colourway or by the supplier's own album name.

heldBack.reason: Germany 2026/27 away shirt — already live as 'Germany 2026/27 Away Jersey'. Same navy body, same mint trim, same adidas Trefoil and four-star crest.

Black Germany tracksuit — already live as '2026 World Cup Germany Jacket set'. That listing's own photographs are all swing tags and trouser close-ups, so the match was made on the supplier album name rather than the lead image; worth a second look.
Maroon Spain jacket — already live as '2026 World Cup Spain Windbreaker'.
Maroon Spain jacket and trousers — already live as '2026 World Cup Spain Training Set jacket suit'.
Navy Spain half-zip set — already live as '2026 World Cup Spain royal blue Half-Zip Training Set'.

Gold, black and white Kappa Kombat shirt — already live as 'South Africa Retro Goalkeeper Jersey (Kappa Kombat)'. Imported as a duplicate first and withdrawn by scripts/fix-south-africa-duplicate-0904b.mjs, which moved its two photographs onto the surviving listing. Missed on the first pass because the dedupe compared the export against the Germany and Spain listings only, and this shirt was neither.
